indications: VYNDAQEL and VYNDAMAX are indicated for the treatment of the cardiomyopathy of wild-type or hereditary transthyretin-mediated amyloidosis (ATTR-CM) in adults to reduce cardiovascular mortality and cardiovascular-related hospitalization.
contraindications: The recommended dosage is either: • VYNDAQEL 80 mg orally once daily, or • VYNDAMAX 61 mg orally once daily ( 2.1 ) • VYNDAMAX and VYNDAQEL are not substitutable on a per mg basis. ( 2.1 )
